}}'''Toke Fearnim''' is a stableowner in [[Jurador]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Fearnim, Toke}}

==Apearance==
Master Fearnim is a wiry man who has a fringe of gray hair.

==Activities==
When [[Matrim Cauthon]] is traveling with [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]] across [[Altara]], Mat goes into Jurador to buy a horse for [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]]. Master Fearnim has his stablehands, [[Adela]] and [[Hurd]], show Mat several horses. After much hard barganing, Mat buys a [[razor]] from Master Fearnim.
